title: The head rush: why standing fast makes you see stars
caption:
Why do you see stars when you stand up too fast?
Our guy ties his shoes, pops up yelling 'All tied up!' - and the world spins into dizzy stars.
It's orthostatic hypotension: standing fast lets gravity drain blood into your legs, briefly starving your brain of oxygen.
Do you get this head rush every morning too?
Share this with the friend who always bolts out of bed!
